Category.Name: Inbound Quote Messages
Category.Description: Inbound Quote Messages (Participant → SIP, Quote Line only). Message Category 'Q' uppercase.

Category.Name: Inbound Trade Messages
Category.Description: Inbound Trade Messages (Participant → SIP, Trade Line only). Message Category 'T' uppercase.

Category.Name: Inbound Control Messages
Category.Description: Inbound Control Messages (Participant → SIP) — sequence and symbol-state inquiries.

Category.Name: Return Administrative Messages
Category.Description: Return Administrative Messages (SIP → Participant). Message Category 'a' lowercase.

Category.Name: Return Control Messages
Category.Description: Return Control Messages (SIP → Participant). Message Category 'c' lowercase.

Message.Name: Protected Exchange Quote Message Short-form Message
Message.Description: Short-format Exchange Quotation Message (QQ). Transmits Bid and Ask price and size from an Exchange to the SIP.

Field.Name: feedSequence
Field.Description: Message Sequence Number, consecutive positive integers starting at 1

Field.Name: Bid
Field.Description: Bid Price (short form, implied 2 decimal precision)

Field.Name: Ask
Field.Description: Ask Price (short form, implied 2 decimal precision)

Message.Name: Protected Exchange Quote Message Long-form Message
Message.Description: Long-format Exchange Quotation Message (QL).

Field.Name: bid
Field.Description: Bid Price (long form, implied 6 decimal precision)

Field.Name: ask
Field.Description: Ask Price (long form, implied 6 decimal precision)

Message.Description: Short-format Exchange Odd-Lot Message (QO). Carries odd-lot price levels via repeating Short-Form Odd Lot Quote Attachments.

Field.Name: olBidLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Bid Levels Attached

Field.Name: olAskLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Ask Levels Attached

Field.Name: Odd Lot Bid Short Form Attachment
Odd Lot Ask Short Form Attachment

Message.Description: Long-format Exchange Odd-Lot Message (QJ).

Field.Name: olAskLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Ask Levels Attached

Field.Name: Odd Lot Bid Long Form Attachment
Odd Lot Ask Long Form Attachment

Field.Name: olBidLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Bid Levels Attached

Field.Name: olAskLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Ask Levels Attached

Field.Name: Odd Lot Bid Short Form Attachment
Odd Lot Ask Short Form Attachment

Message.Description: Long-format Exchange Combined Quotation Message (QK).

Field.Name: olBidLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Bid Levels Attached

Field.Name: olAskLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Ask Levels Attached

Field.Name: Odd Lot Bid Long Form Attachment
Odd Lot Ask Long Form Attachment

Message.Name: FINRA Protected Quote Message with BBO Info Message
Message.Description: FINRA BBO Quote Message w BBO Info (QG).

Message.Name: FINRA Protected Quote Message without BBO Info Message
Message.Description: FINRA BBO Quote Message without BBO Info (QF).

Message.Name: FINRA ADF Odd Lot Quotation Message
Message.Description: ADF Odd Lot Quotation Message (QH).

Field.Name: olBidLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Bid Levels Attached

Field.Name: olAskLevelCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Ask Levels Attached

Field.Name: Odd Lot Bid ADF Form Attachment
Odd Lot Ask ADF Form Attachment

Message.Name: FINRA ADF Combined Quote Message with BBO
Message.Description: FINRA ADF Combined Quote Message with BBO (QR).

Field.Name: olBidLevelCount

Odd Lot Ask ADF Form Attachment

Message.Name: Regular Trade Report Message
Message.Description: Regular Trade Report Message (TE). Carries whole-share last sale reports from an Exchange to the SIP.

Field.Name: tradeId
Field.Description: Trade Identifier — per-symbol sequence starting at 1

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Error Message
Message.Description: Trade Cancel/Error Message (TI). Cancels or errors a previously delivered trade.

Field.Name: origTradeId
Field.Description: Original Trade Id of trade being acted on

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Trade Correction Message (TJ). Corrects a previously delivered trade with new values.

Field.Name: tradeId
Field.Description: Trade Id for the corrected trade

Field.Name: origTradeId
Field.Description: Original Trade Id of trade being acted on

Message.Name: As Of Trade Report Message
Message.Description: As/Of Trade Report Message (TH). Reports a trade from a prior session date.

Field.Name: tradeTime
Field.Description: Time of trade (may be prior day, nanoseconds since Epoch)

Message.Name: Fractional Regular Trade Report Message
Message.Description: Fractional Regular Trade Report Message (TK). Last sale report with implied 6-decimal fractional volume.

Message.Name: Fractional Trade Cancel Error Message
Message.Description: Fractional Trade Cancel/Error Message (TO).

Message.Name: Fractional Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Fractional Trade Correction Message (TP).

Field.Name: tradeId
Field.Description: Trade Id for the corrected trade

Message.Name: Fractional As Of Trade Report Message
Message.Description: Fractional As/Of Trade Report Message (TQ).

Field.Name: tradeTime
Field.Description: Time of trade (may be prior day)

Message.Name: General Administrative Message
Message.Description: General Administrative Message (AA). Delivers free-form text information that does not fit other admin categories. Variable-length text field with length in textLen.

Field.Name: text
Field.Description: Text body (length contained in textLen, max 300)

Message.Name: Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Trading Action Message (AO). Listing market notifies SIP of halts and other trading state events.

Field.Name: actionSequence
Field.Description: Trading Action Sequence Number — per-symbol sequence

Field.Name: actionTime
Field.Description: Time Action occurred (may be prior day)

Message.Name: Market Center Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Market Center Trading Action Message (AJ). Participant-specific trading halt on the participant's own market only.

Message.Name: Market Center Mass Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Market Center Mass Trading Action Message (AU). Applies action across a range of securities. No acknowledgement is returned.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message (AV). Notifies that a security has breached the short sale price test threshold.

Field.Name: action
Field.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Restricted Action

Message.Name: Opening Reference Midpoint Price Message
Message.Description: Opening Reference Midpoint Price Message (AM). Listing market provides midpoint reference price for LULD calculations.

Message.Name: T1 Adjusted Closing Price Message
Message.Description: T1 Adjusted Closing Price Message (AN). Listing market provides closing price for LULD calculations.

Message.Name: Market Open Message
Message.Description: Market Open Message (AX). Indicates participant quotes should be marked as opened.

Message.Name: Market Closed Message
Message.Description: Market Closed Message (AY). Indicates the trading session is ready to close.

Message.Name: Auction Collar Message
Message.Description: Auction Collar Message (AE). Listing market provides new Price Protection Limits used during LULD trading pauses (and during extended operational hours).

Field.Name: CollarReferencePrice
Field.Description: Reference price used to set collar

Message.Name: Sequence Inquiry Message
Message.Description: Sequence Inquiry Message (CC). Participant requests current expected sequence number from SIP.

Message.Name: Symbol State Inquiry Message
Message.Description: Symbol State Inquiry Message (CS). Participant requests current per-symbol state from SIP.

Message.Name: End Of Participant Reporting Message
Message.Description: End Of Participant Reporting Message (CG). Participant signals it has finished reporting for the session.

Message.Name: Return General Administrative Message
Message.Description: Return General Administrative Message (aA). SIP returns free-form text to the participant. Originator Id is SU.

Message.Name: Return Market Center Trading Action Acknowledgement Message
Message.Description: Market Center Trading Action Acknowledgement Message (aJ). Acknowledges a Market Center Trading Action (AJ).

Field.Name: orig
Field.Description: Originating Participant of the original AJ

Message.Name: Return Market Open Message
Message.Description: Return Market Open Message (aX). SIP confirms market is open.

Message.Name: Return Market Closed Message
Message.Description: Return Market Closed Message (aY). SIP confirms market is closed.

Message.Name: Reject Message
Message.Description: Reject Message (aR). SIP returns this message when an inbound message is rejected. syntaxViolation 'Y' indicates a syntax error and the port will be disconnected.

Field.Name: feedSequence
Field.Description: Inbound Feed Sequence Number of the Rejected Message (0 for syntax errors)

Field.Name: partToken
Field.Description: Participant Token of the Rejected Message (0 for syntax errors)

Field.Name: rejectCode
Field.Description: Error Code for the First Diagnosed Error

Message.Name: Sequence Acknowledgement Message
Message.Description: Sequence Acknowledgement Message (aK). SIP positively acknowledges receipt of an inbound message when the port is configured for acknowledgements.

Field.Name: feedSequence
Field.Description: Inbound Feed Sequence Number of the Original Message

Field.Name: partToken
Field.Description: Participant Token of the Original Message

Message.Name: Participant Input Warning Message
Message.Description: Participant Input Warning Message (aW). Sent when an inbound quote message would exceed odd-lot price-level limits. Carries the unprocessed price levels as attachments whose form is selected by olAttachmenType (2=Short, 3=Long, 5=ADF MPID). The attached price levels are not enumerated as Pdf.xml groups in this version — extend in a follow-up release when the loader's value-gated Optional rules are wired through Edits.xml.

Field.Name: feedSequence
Field.Description: Inbound Feed Sequence Number of Input Transaction

Field.Name: warningCode
Field.Description: Warning Code (typically 101 for excess odd-lot levels)

Field.Name: olAttachmenType
Field.Description: Odd Lot Attachment Type (2=Short form, 3=Long form, 5=ADF MPID form)

Field.Name: olAttachmentCount
Field.Description: Number of Odd Lot Price Level Attachments that follow

Message.Name: Start Of Day Message
Message.Description: Start Of Day Message (cE). SIP signals it is open and ready to receive messages from participants.

Message.Name: End Of Day Message
Message.Description: End Of Day Message (cF). SIP signals it has no further data or control messages for the day and is shutting down.

Message.Name: Sequence Inquiry Response Message
Message.Description: Sequence Inquiry Response Message (cC). Sent unsequenced in response to a CC inquiry. Carries the next expected feedSequence, last partToken received, and the present SIP state.

Field.Name: partToken
Field.Description: Last Participant Token received by the SIP

Field.Name: sipState
Field.Description: Present SIP State (N=Before SOD, S=After SOD, E=After EOD)

Message.Name: Symbol State Inquiry Response Message
Message.Description: Symbol State Inquiry Response Message (cS). Sent unsequenced in response to a CS inquiry. Carries next expected tradeId, next actionSequence, and the symbolState.

Field.Name: nextTradeId
Field.Description: Next Expected Trade Id (0 for Quote lines)

Field.Name: symbolState
Field.Description: Symbol Trading Status (H=Halt, Q=Quotation, T=Trading, P=Volatility Pause)

Group.Name: Odd Lot Bid Short Form Attachment
Group.Description: Short-form Odd Lot Quote Attachment for the bid side. Repeats olBidLevelCount times.

Group.Name: Odd Lot Ask Short Form Attachment
Group.Description: Short-form Odd Lot Quote Attachment for the ask side. Repeats olAskLevelCount times.

Group.Name: Odd Lot Bid Long Form Attachment
Group.Description: Long-form Odd Lot Quote Attachment for the bid side. Repeats olBidLevelCount times.

Group.Name: Odd Lot Ask Long Form Attachment
Group.Description: Long-form Odd Lot Quote Attachment for the ask side. Repeats olAskLevelCount times.

Group.Name: Odd Lot Bid ADF Form Attachment
Group.Description: ADF-form Odd Lot Quote Attachment for the bid side, including FINRA mpid attribution. Repeats olBidLevelCount times.

Group.Name: Odd Lot Ask ADF Form Attachment
Group.Description: ADF-form Odd Lot Quote Attachment for the ask side, including FINRA mpid attribution. Repeats olAskLevelCount times.
